reimport_hourly_statistics.name: Reimport hourly statistics
reimport_hourly_statistics.description: Force a full reimport of hourly electricity and gas statistics from the Greenchoice API starting from the given date up to and including yesterday. Existing recorder data for the range is overwritten and cumulative sums are recalculated, which fixes gaps, negative spikes, or other artefacts in the Energy dashboard.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Greenchoice account to reimport. Leave empty to reimport all configured accounts.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first day to reimport (inclusive). All days through yesterday will be fetched from the API and written to the recorder.

yaml_deprecation.title: YAML configuration is deprecated
yaml_deprecation.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

To continue using this integration, please:
1. Remove the `{domain}` configuration from your configuration.yaml file
2. Restart Home Assistant
3. Go to Settings > Devices & Services
4. Click 'Add Integration' and find {integration_title}
5. Follow the setup wizard to configure the integration.

init.title: Greenchoice options
init.description: How many days of history to import on the first refresh after each Home Assistant start. The default of 7 days is what the API keeps reliably available. A longer horizon costs one API call per extra day every time Home Assistant restarts, so raise it only if you accept that; only days Greenchoice has actually published are imported. To fetch one specific range instead, use the 'Reimport hourly statistics' action.
